The problem this solution exists for
Billing systems resist product change; churn is discovered at cancellation; usage-based pricing is unmeasured, so monetization innovations stall.
Our approach
We modernize billing to event-driven usage metering, wire retention decision hubs to intent signals, and build expansion models (usage → upsell) with experiment evidence.

blocks.x: Platform stack

The stack for Subscription & Monetization Platforms is assembled per estate, but the pattern is stable: one event spine, one governance plane, one decision layer — and no component without a named owner.
